hallazgos.detalle: La historia solo consume la actualización del número de celular o correo electrónico, pero se clasifica como OWNED_CONTRACT.
El service_role describe mantenimiento de datos de referencia, no el verbo+objeto 'actualizar número de celular o correo electrónico' de la historia.
El envío de notificación de cambio podría ser cubierto por el Service Domain Customer Case, pero está descartado.

revision_adversarial.resumen: Se identificaron tres hallazgos: una dependencia promocionada a contrato y un service role que no describe la acción directa en Party Reference Data Directory, y la omisión del Service Domain Customer Case para la notificación de cambio.

candidatos_directos.rol_bian: This service domain handles the automated generation of (batches of) pre-formatted correspondence. It also handles the tracking of expected responses to sent out mail requests and handles the matching of the response and the onward routing of these and all unsolicited inbound correspondence.

candidatos_directos.justificacion: La historia actualiza datos de contacto como celular y correo, lo cual mapea directamente al comportamiento y esquema Reference del Service Domain Party Reference Data Directory.
candidatos_directos.rol_bian: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data that might be used in any interaction between the bank and the party including relationship development, sales/marketing, servicing and product delivery. This can include general reference and contact details, party associations, demographic details and some servicing preferences. Different information may be maintained for different party types such as individuals, corporates, partners
observaciones_adversariales: [adversarial] La historia solo consume la actualización del número de celular o correo electrónico, pero se clasifica como OWNED_CONTRACT.

assumptions: El envío de notificaciones forma parte de la ejecución o es manejado por eventos del mismo dominio de datos de referencia.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia administra el envío de notificaciones de cambio de datos personales; el Service Domain Customer Case solo define operaciones de caso (Initiate, Update, Control, etc.) y sus objetos (CustomerCaseProcedure, Analysis, Determination, Resolution) que no coinciden con los objetos ni acciones de la historia.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: Case resolution tasks follow specific procedures for the type of case involved. Case resolution can be quick by applying resolution rules and obtaining additional authorization as necessary, or they can be long living activities, for example where documentation is requested and has to be retrieved from merchants or other interested parties before the disputed issue can finally be ruled upon. A wide range of case types can be expected
observaciones_adversariales: [adversarial] El envío de notificación de cambio podría ser cubierto por el Service Domain Customer Case, pero está descartado.
assumptions: Se requiere coincidencia literal del verbo con el action term; 'registrar' no se equipara a 'Update'
gaps: Ausencia de operación que envíe o genere notificaciones de cambio de datos personales

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: El dominio Party Authentication se enfoca en la verificación de identidad y autenticación de clientes. La historia de usuario trata sobre el envío de notificaciones tras la actualización de datos personales, lo cual no es responsabilidad de este dominio.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: Customer/party authentication is a cross-channel/device capability that provides identity confirmation for customers accessing the bank through any interactive channel. The service may use a combination of one or more mechanisms to authenticate including issued tokens/devices, virtual mechanisms such as passwords and biometrics such as voice/face recognition. Different levels of authentication may be determined to support different types of access and there may be access permissions associated with the authentication mechanism used

service_domains_omitidos.rol_bian: The Customer Agreement service domain captures and maintains the master legal terms of conditions in force for a customer (which as noted can be a complex multinational with many underlying product and service specific agreements).

This service domain provides a general customer billing service. The service domain is provided with the applicable fees and charges that are authorized for invoicing typically by a product or service fulfillment service domain. Processing can include verification and authorizations steps and the invoice could be issued as a single transaction or a schedule of transactions.

This service domain administers customer consents for their preferences and constraints on accepting direct debit collection requests, request to pay against their accounts held at the bank, or preferences for credit transfer (e.g. payment rail, preferred funding account, etc.)

The Offer Management Service Domain can process offers for all types of customers and any allowed combination of product or service. It references the Product Directory for the product specific offer instructions it must follow. The offer process may combine the selection of product/service specific details (e.g. pricing & negotiation ranges, documentation/authorization/regulatory requirements, eligibility and declarations, credit and other customer details), customer specific details (e.g. credit standing, other classifications such as operational overhead/retention target/activity history, demographics and segmentation). The service domain orchestrates a potentially complex/multi-threaded/multi stage workflow to get the offer to the point where the product/service can be initiated.

Maintain a portfolio of view of the customer base with key customer data and consolidated activity details to support profitability and performance analysis across many possible customer segment dimensions

El dominio Party Reference Data Directory es propiedad directa, con evidencia de ownership en la historia y decisión UNRESOLVED.
